verses.1: Where are the wars and where are the battles among you? Not from anywhere else, but from those pleasures that you enjoy during your battles.
verses.2: You desire, yet you do not have what you want. You kill and covet, yet you cannot succeed. You fight and engage in battles. You don’t have what you need because you refuse to ask for it.
verses.3: Also, do not accept these requests, because you have asked for them in a bad way, so that you can spend money on things that are not necessary.
verses.4: Fools, didn’t you know that friendship with the world is actually hatred towards God? Anyone who wants to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God.
verses.5: Do you think that the text is meaningless? For the sake of scandal, does the spirit that has left us go away in vain?
verses.6: But they give more willingly. Therefore, he says: “The Lord opposes the proud with humility, while those who give willingly.”
verses.7: Therefore, submit yourselves to the God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.8: You have touched the God, and He will also touch you. Purify your hands, you sinners, and cleanse your hearts, you hypocrites.
verses.9: You suffered, mourned, and cried. Your joy turned into sorrow, and your happiness became despair.
verses.10: Be humble before your Lord, and He will exalt you.
verses.11: Do not deceive each other, brothers. Those who deceive or judge their brothers are acting against the law. If you judge according to the law, then you are not a lawmaker, but a judge.
verses.12: One is a lawmaker and a judge, someone who has the power to create laws and to judge others. But who are you, then, who judge those around you?
verses.13: Let those who speak do so now. Today or tomorrow, we will go to this city. There, we will do business and make a profit.
verses.14: Don’t you wonder what kind of life you will have on that day? After all, it’s like a fleeting moment; it appears for a short time, and then it disappears.
verses.15: Instead of telling you this, if the Lord desires it, let us do this or that.
verses.16: Now, then, be proud in your arrogance! All such pride is evil.
verses.17: For it is a sin for him to do something good, and not to do it at all.
